summary: BGIN BLOCKCHAIN LIMITED filed a Form 6-K disclosing its election as a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer to rely on Nasdaq home-country rule exemptions under Listing Rule 5615. The company will follow Cayman practice in lieu of Nasdaq Listing Rule 5620(a), which requires an annual shareholder meeting within one year of fiscal year-end, and Listing Rule 5635(c), which requires shareholder approval before establishing or materially amending equity compensation plans. No terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are stated. The filing is a routine governance disclosure, not a special situation; no deal or risk-arb angle applies.
